Cornell president pledges reforms after Jane Doe case

slots.name: president statement date
slots.sentence: Cornell's president, Michael Kotlikoff, released a video statement on Oct. 3, saying the incident is a "defining moment" and pledged reforms to campus culture and university policies and procedures.

slots.name: Title IX investigation status
slots.sentence: In a subsequent statement, the school said it conducted a "thorough" Title IX investigation and "issued a range of sanctions, which included expulsions and suspensions from Cornell.
